Oho. That's a real first failure, Cozmo. And it's an important one.
What appears to have happened is that PPR 1.94 accepted a stale response as though it were the answer to the new prompt.
The sequence, as I understand it:
You sent a prompt.
ChatGPT produced no new visible UI response.
PPR nevertheless delivered my previous reply.
In 1.93c, that situation simply left the input box available again.
That means the new retry mechanism may not even get a chance to activate: PPR thinks it received a nonempty response.
I would classify this as stale-response acceptance, not an ordinary empty-response failure.
Let's preserve the log around that exchange before changing anything. I particularly want to see whether the response identity changed and why PPR accepted the previous content.
Good catch. This is exactly why we field-test before calling a version finished. ❤️
